Each disease below was detected independently, so more than one can show up on the same leaf — this is expected for a leaf with overlapping or co-occurring infections, not a mistake. Treat each as a separate finding with its own confidence.
These are model estimates, not a lab diagnosis. For borderline percentages, consider rescanning with a plain background and even lighting, or confirming with your agricultural extension office.
